name: TenantScope
invariant: The server derives agency membership and client/project ownership; callers cannot self-assert access.

fields.name: agencyId
fields.description: Owning agency, checked against membership and persisted foreign keys.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: End-client workspace where applicable; absence never means cross-client access.

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Project scope when the operation is project-bound.

name: SourceLocator
flow: Parser → profile, plan, lineage and verifier
invariant: A locator identifies an occurrence, not merely equal content.

fields.name: revisionId
fields.description: Sealed revision that fixes raw bytes and parser choices.

fields.name: fileId
fields.description: Accepted file entry, not its display name.

fields.name: logicalRow
fields.description: Zero-based logical data-record ordinal excluding header.

fields.name: projectionId
fields.description: Declared object projection within the physical row.

name: FileManifest
invariant: Only provider-observed bytes and generations may be admitted.

fields.name: storageRef
fields.description: Private registry reference, never a public bucket URI.

fields.name: providerGeneration
fields.description: Exact immutable generation observed after upload.

fields.name: sha256
fields.description: Hash recomputed over the complete object bytes.

fields.name: bytes
fields.description: Observed byte length within the applicable envelope.

fields.name: scanState
fields.description: Coverage is separate from malware absence.

fields.name: parserProfileHash
fields.description: Pinned encoding, dialect, workbook and parser configuration.

fields.name: admitted
fields.description: Derived server decision; a browser cannot set this value.

name: DatasetRevision
invariant: Sealing is immutable; replacement creates lineage and invalidates dependent authority.

fields.name: manifestHash
fields.description: Digest of sealed manifest under the declared canonical profile.

fields.name: supersedesRevisionId
fields.description: Explicit predecessor, never an in-place overwrite.

name: SourceField
invariant: Labels are untrusted text and positional identity prevents duplicate-header overwrite.

fields.name: fieldId
fields.description: Stable positional field identity within a table.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Original decoded header, escaped in UI and classified before model use.

fields.name: observedType
fields.description: Measurement classification, not permission to coerce.

fields.name: privacy
fields.description: Classification from actual content and meaning.

fields.name: profileHash
fields.description: Binding to the full measured profile.

name: RowCounts
flow: Independent counters → quote, validation and report
invariant: Counters have named denominators and cannot be substituted for one another.

fields.name: physicalSourceRows
fields.description: Admitted data occurrences before object projection.

fields.name: logicalSourceRecords
fields.description: Source object occurrences after explicit projection.

fields.name: billableSourceUnits
fields.description: Units selected by the pricing definition, frozen before capture.

fields.name: associationEdges
fields.description: Relationship candidates admitted within the edge envelope.

fields.name: emittedRepresentatives
fields.description: Terminal source representatives represented in output.

fields.name: mergedNonSurvivors
fields.description: Source occurrences accounted for by a selected survivor.

fields.name: rejected
fields.description: Terminal rejected source units with reasons.

fields.name: withheld
fields.description: Explicitly withheld source units with disposition.

fields.name: unresolved
fields.description: Nonterminal decisions; positive value blocks final acceptance.

fields.name: emittedArtifactRows
fields.description: Actual output lines excluding headers; not a conservation proxy.

name: FieldProfile
invariant: A sample can describe a sample only; exact claims require complete measured scope.

fields.name: nullCount
fields.description: Typed null or absent count according to parser policy.

fields.name: emptyStringCount
fields.description: Exact decoded empty strings, separately counted.

fields.name: distinctCount
fields.description: Exact distinct count only if exact=true.

fields.name: exact
fields.description: Whether the claimed measure covers the complete scope.

fields.name: issues
fields.description: Stable issue codes; raw cells remain in authorized evidence storage.

name: UniquenessProof
invariant: Uniqueness is scoped by provider, instance, object, field and null/case semantics.

fields.name: completeScope
fields.description: True only for the required full scope.

fields.name: evidenceHash
fields.description: Verifiable underlying measurement or authoritative metadata.

fields.name: observedAt
fields.description: Time of observation, checked for future/staleness.

fields.name: operation
fields.description: Operation for which this proof is admissible.

name: TargetField
invariant: Actual API names, writability, types and constraints control output.

fields.name: apiName
fields.description: Exact field API name, not translated display label.

fields.name: createable
fields.description: Actual create capability. Null is explicitly unknown and cannot authorize the operation.

fields.name: updateable
fields.description: Actual update capability. Null is explicitly unknown and cannot authorize the operation.

fields.name: requiredOnCreate
fields.description: Observed create requirement, including object profile rules. Null is explicitly unknown and cannot authorize the operation.

fields.name: maxLength
fields.description: Character or byte unit is specified in the owning importer profile.

fields.name: allowedValues
fields.description: Complete allowed option API values when relevant; labels may be sensitive.

fields.name: clearMechanism
fields.description: Qualified mechanism; blank is not assumed clear.

fields.name: unique
fields.description: Metadata claim still requires correct scope and semantics.

fields.name: nillable
fields.description: Whether the actual target permits null; null means unknown.

fields.name: constraintStatus
fields.description: Evidence status of the field constraints; does not grant authority by itself.

fields.name: allowedValuesStatus
fields.description: An empty list with UNKNOWN is not an unconstrained enum.

fields.name: constraintEvidenceHash
fields.description: Verified field-specific metadata and dependent/record-type constraint evidence.

name: TargetObject
invariant: Only declared object operations and fields may be compiled.

fields.name: operations
fields.description: Qualified CREATE, UPDATE and/or UPSERT operations.

fields.name: identifierFields
fields.description: Eligible identity API fields, each with its own proof.

fields.name: relationships
fields.description: Qualified relationship API names, not arbitrary dotted paths.

name: TargetContract
flow: Authenticated observer plus agency confirmation → MC/IC
invariant: Hash/body/mode/instance/tool/authority all bind together.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Public mode; legacy adapter mapping is explicit.

fields.name: bodyHash
fields.description: Digest of the immutable target-body preimage defined in HASHING_AND_ACCOUNTING_RULES; confirmation and attestation envelope are verified separately.

fields.name: confirmedAt
fields.description: Agency confirmation of this exact version.

fields.name: capabilityVersion
fields.description: Version of the supported capability matrix.

name: ValueIntent
invariant: SET requires an exact value; CLEAR requires an authority binding; other kinds cannot smuggle values.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Exact typed value for SET only; large numeric values use decimal strings.

fields.name: authorityHash
fields.description: Scoped agency-decision/effect evidence hash, not the final PlanApproval hash; prevents circular plan authority.

fields.name: reasonCode
fields.description: Stable reason with evidence in the decision record.

name: DecisionEvidence
invariant: A rationale cannot invent its own facts; every decision names verifiable inputs.

fields.name: provenance
fields.description: Decision origin, not authority level by itself.

fields.name: factHashes
fields.description: Profile, target, agency or compatible memory facts actually checked.

fields.name: comparisonHash
fields.description: Recorded comparison over the referenced facts.

fields.name: actorId
fields.description: Required for agency decisions; opaque authorized identity.

name: FieldMapping
invariant: Same target field in distinct source-object scopes is not automatically a conflict.

name: IdentityDecision
invariant: Similarity does not grant merge or update identity.

fields.name: proof
fields.description: Scoped proof required where the strategy relies on it.

fields.name: fieldConflictPolicyHash
fields.description: Per-field conflict resolution, including consent restrictions.

fields.name: approvalHash
fields.description: Scoped agency-decision/effect evidence hash, not the final PlanApproval hash; prevents circular plan authority.

name: TransformStep
invariant: Parameters use a primitive-specific closed schema, not arbitrary executable code.

fields.name: primitive
fields.description: Member of the qualified primitive catalogue.

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.description: Predecessor steps in an acyclic graph.

name: RelationshipDecision
invariant: Every endpoint is scoped and every edge gets a disposition.

fields.name: requiredStageId
fields.description: Parent stage whose receipt supplies new IDs.

fields.name: approvalHash
fields.description: Scoped agency-decision/effect evidence hash, not the final PlanApproval hash; prevents circular plan authority.

name: Plan
flow: Compiler and authorized edits → full validation
invariant: A plan revision is immutable after validation/approval and cannot execute from a stale binding.

fields.name: bodyHash
fields.description: Digest of immutable plan semantics; lifecycle state/version envelope and final approval are excluded by the named preimage.

name: Approval
invariant: Approval is a signed-off subject, not a mutable boolean.

fields.name: disclosuresHash
fields.description: UI-disclosed effects, counts, risks and limitations.

name: ValidationReceipt
invariant: All bindings and evidence digests are required, internally consistent and independently checked.

fields.name: artifactEvidenceHash
fields.description: Output/preview validation evidence for this phase.

fields.name: completedAt
fields.description: Completion, not before start or in the future.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Explicit result; no truthy success coercion.

name: ModelTask
invariant: The candidate set and policy are part of idempotency identity.

fields.name: minimizedRequestHash
fields.description: Hash of complete final serialized outbound content.

fields.name: interpretationDeadline
fields.description: No new semantic calls after this deadline.

name: RequestJournal
flow: Durable orchestrator → recovery and cost reconciler
invariant: Persist response before marking consumed; ambiguity is an explicit state.

fields.name: requestHash
fields.description: Exact final request bytes or canonical transport representation.

fields.name: responseArtifactHash
fields.description: Required once a complete response is durable.

fields.name: actualCents
fields.description: Known billed/estimated usage under explicit status.

name: Lease
invariant: An old live worker cannot publish after another owner advances the fence.

fields.name: cancelVersion
fields.description: Cancellation generation observed by the worker.

name: Quote
invariant: Price validity is separate from source availability; terms are immutable once issued.

fields.name: discountCents
fields.description: Applied maximum eligible promotion, not stacked.

fields.name: termsHash
fields.description: Accepted scope, refund, retention and contract terms.

name: PaymentOrder
invariant: Local intent precedes provider effect; order identity cannot migrate between tenants.

fields.name: idempotencyHash
fields.description: Intent binding; same key different payload conflicts.

name: CaptureFact
invariant: Browser claims cannot produce a capture fact.

fields.name: merchantRef
fields.description: Observed payee matched to expected merchant.

fields.name: environment
fields.description: Must match the order and production gate.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Provider state mapped without optimistic coercion.

fields.name: evidenceHash
fields.description: Authenticated event/query evidence, minimized for retention.

name: Refund
invariant: A refund is a reconciled effect, not merely a submitted request.

fields.name: authorizationHash
fields.description: Required approval or standing authorized policy reference.

name: Settlement
invariant: Captured, held, withdrawn and bank-available funds are distinct.

fields.name: withdrawnCents
fields.description: Funds sent to bank, not automatically credited.

fields.name: bankAvailableCents
fields.description: Actually available amount under observed statement.

name: CommercialAuthorization
invariant: Every prerequisite binds the same source and policy; server creates this record.

fields.name: revokedAt
fields.description: Prevents future execution/finalization as defined by state.

name: Job
invariant: One logical job may have attempts; only a fenced accepted attempt publishes.

fields.name: providerJobId
fields.description: Actual Batch or equivalent execution identity.

fields.name: inputBindingHash
fields.description: Source, plan, target, core and policy bundle.

fields.name: packageId
fields.description: Accepted output, present only after verified publication.

name: ImportStage
flow: Stage compiler → agency import and continuation
invariant: A stage is a preparation step, not proof the customer imported successfully.

name: StageReceipt
flow: Agency upload plus validator → child-stage compiler
invariant: Receipt scope, membership, target IDs and completeness must be proved.

fields.name: stageId
fields.description: Exact stage that produced the imported records.

fields.name: unresolvedRows
fields.description: Missing/ambiguous mappings, which block dependent edges.

name: Artifact
invariant: Artifact role, bytes, identity and privacy determine its use.

fields.name: relativePath
fields.description: Portable normalized path with traversal/absolute/control characters rejected.

fields.name: recordCount
fields.description: Declared data records excluding headers where relevant.

fields.name: objectApiName
fields.description: Exact target object for import files.

name: PackageManifest
invariant: Hashes alone do not prove conservation or permitted target effects.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Creation metadata excluded from deterministic content where specified.

name: DeletionRequest
flow: Authorized request/retention scheduler → cleanup and restore
invariant: Delete authority revokes new work before cleanup and survives backup restore.

fields.name: residualClasses
fields.description: Lawful financial/security or provider-retained residuals, explicitly named.

name: Agency
invariant: An agency may contain many end clients; the seller does not gain CRM access.

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Safe agency label, not a unique legal identity.

name: Membership
invariant: Membership capabilities are assigned by authorized commands, never browser claims.

name: EndClient
invariant: Client labels are presentation; legal and data boundaries remain explicit.

fields.name: processingAuthorityRef
fields.description: Agency evidence of authority to provide this client's data.

name: Prospect
invariant: Prospect data remains limited to lawful commercial context.

fields.name: businessContactRef
fields.description: Restricted contact record, not raw details in reports.

fields.name: sourceEvidenceHash
fields.description: Where and why the prospect was legitimately collected.

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: Applicable outreach territory, not guessed from language alone.

fields.name: suppressed
fields.description: Global no-send control that overrides automation.

name: AttributionClaim
invariant: Accepted acquisition rights differ from current account servicing.

fields.name: sellerId
fields.description: Claiming person under an active agreement.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.description: Ninety-day initial claim window unless documented qualifying extension applies.

fields.name: evidenceHash
fields.description: Substantive acquisition evidence, not a scraped list.

name: SellerAgreement
invariant: Actual legal classification requires substance-based review before activation.

fields.name: firstBps
fields.description: Initial 1000 basis points unless a prospective signed exception.

name: CommissionEntitlement
flow: Qualifying captures and accepted attribution → seller ledger
invariant: Rate and window bind a historical agency acquisition; refunds adjust the basis.

fields.name: shareBps
fields.description: Share of the commission pool, totals exactly 10000 across a split.

name: CommissionLine
invariant: Calculate cumulative entitlement in exact minor units and derive adjustments.

fields.name: netServiceBasisCents
fields.description: Service collected after discount and cumulative refunds, excluding tax.

fields.name: previousPostedCents
fields.description: Prior positive total before explicit adjustments.

fields.name: eligibleAt
fields.description: Thirty days after final contracted preparation completion plus stated conditions.

name: CommissionStatement
flow: Monthly close → seller reconciliation and payout
invariant: Statements reveal each project and adjustment without exposing customer CRM data.

fields.name: lineIds
fields.description: Complete included commission and adjustment references.

fields.name: payableCents
fields.description: Actual payable amount after reconciled adjustments.

fields.name: heldCents
fields.description: Held with specific reason and review date.

fields.name: payoutEvidenceHash
fields.description: Actual settled payout evidence, not only submission.

name: FiscalProfile
flow: Reviewed operator/customer tax facts → invoice adapter
invariant: No default tax rate can substitute for actual fiscal applicability.

name: TaxDocument
invariant: Provider issuance uncertainty is reconciled by exact identity before retry.

name: LedgerEntry
invariant: The ledger is append-only; corrections use reversal and new entries.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO currency for this ledger partition.

fields.name: sourceRef
fields.description: Capture, refund, fee, payout or reviewed adjustment.

name: SupportCase
invariant: Support metadata must not become an unrestricted raw-data channel.

name: Incident
invariant: Containment, restoration and customer communication are separately evidenced.

fields.name: affectedScopes
fields.description: Safe scope identifiers, no raw customer values.

name: Capability
invariant: Requested, implemented and qualified are different states.

fields.name: qualificationEvidenceHashes
fields.description: Independent evidence on the accepted candidate.

name: GateEvidence
invariant: Evidence names an exact subject, command, result, environment and immutable artifact.

fields.name: exitCode
fields.description: Observed exit, not a summarized success word.

name: Finding
invariant: A finding separates expected behavior, observed result and harness limitations.

fields.name: affectedEvidence
fields.description: Evidence to invalidate or retain with reason.

name: OwnerAction
invariant: An unmaterialized card is not an instruction to click a guessed UI.

fields.name: destination
fields.description: Verified current URL/screen or actual professional recipient.

fields.name: requiredInput
fields.description: Minimal private fact or consent, without secrets in this source.

fields.name: maximumCostCents
fields.description: Concrete ceiling when spending is involved.

fields.name: agentPreparationHash
fields.description: Evidence the technical work is already prepared.

name: UploadSession
invariant: Application acceptance and provider session lifetime are independent.

fields.name: providerSessionSecretRef
fields.description: Private bearer reference; never included in generic DTO/logs.

name: Audit
invariant: The logical audit retains its original deadlines and grant across retries.

fields.name: candidateManifestHash
fields.description: Complete expected candidate set after planning.

name: CostGrant
invariant: A monthly funding statement is not a grant of currently available money.

fields.name: reconciledSpendCents
fields.description: Known consumption under the actual tariff.

fields.name: availableCents
fields.description: Derived remaining amount; never browser-provided authority.

fields.name: priceProfileHash
fields.description: Exact dated rates and conservative overhead.

name: Candidate
invariant: Coverage and permissible choices are fixed before provider response evaluation.

fields.name: alternativeIds
fields.description: Closed allowed alternatives including explicit abstention where appropriate.

name: MemoryDecision
flow: Previously accepted scoped decision → future candidate assistance
invariant: Memory is evidence with scope and expiry, never automatic authority.

name: PrimitiveDefinition
invariant: A primitive is executable only within its typed input/output/effect contract.

fields.name: requiresAgencyAuthority
fields.description: Necessary but not sufficient approval condition.

name: PaymentAttempt
invariant: Network failure alone cannot establish no external effect.

name: PriceEligibilitySnapshot
invariant: A price snapshot cannot change after capture because later history changes.

fields.name: qualifyingProjectIds
fields.description: Complete prior distinct paid/non-fully-refunded project set.

fields.name: qualifyingCount
fields.description: Must equal that unique set size.

name: RetentionRecord
invariant: The effective deadline is a minimum of named anchors; retries do not extend it.

fields.name: softDeadline
fields.description: Policy interval from the applicable ready event.

fields.name: hardDeadline
fields.description: Absolute maximum from the owning immutable event.

fields.name: effectiveDeadline
fields.description: Minimum active deadline after all relevant caps.

fields.name: providerResiduals
fields.description: Observed classes that outlive active access with reasons.

name: DomainEvent
invariant: Payload is allowlisted references and safe counts, never raw CRM rows.

name: OutboxRecord
invariant: Outbox delivery is not the business effect itself.

name: InboxRecord
invariant: Environment and provider identity participate in deduplication.

name: QualificationRun
invariant: Run identity must represent a separate actual invocation on the same candidate.

fields.name: status
fields.description: No incomplete run counted as qualification.

name: ModelProfile
invariant: A model name alone is not an eligible transport or production winner.

fields.name: endpointProfileHash
fields.description: Request shape and audience binding without credentials.

name: ReportSnapshot
invariant: Presentation cannot invent facts or expose raw data beyond the chosen report class.

name: ReleaseCandidate
invariant: A changed dependency or image produces a different candidate even with identical source text.

fields.name: imageDigests
fields.description: Exact OCI content digests without display aliases.

name: CommissionAdjustment
invariant: An adjustment records a difference without editing historical paid lines.

fields.name: amountCents
fields.description: Exact difference from prior cumulative entitlement.

fields.name: sourceEventId
fields.description: Reconciled financial or reviewed correction event.

name: OutreachDraft
invariant: Editing a draft cannot send it or imply recipient permission.

fields.name: contentRef
fields.description: Private draft content reference; never raw customer CRM.

name: OutreachAuthorization
invariant: Permission is specific to recipients, content, sender, purpose, time and count.

fields.name: maximumSends
fields.description: Bounded positive maximum, also no greater than sealed unique drafts.

fields.name: policyVersion
fields.description: Applicable provider, suppression and contact policy.

fields.name: revoked
fields.description: Current server-observed revocation, checked at dispatch.

name: SalesActivity
invariant: Observed submission, receipt and customer response are different facts.

fields.name: occurredAt
fields.description: Observed event time; unknown time cannot be fabricated.

fields.name: providerMessageRef
fields.description: Opaque external identity or explicit NONE for a local suppression.
